import json,pathlib,subprocess,hashlib,re
p=pathlib.Path('.ai/task/awkward-explanations-adjust-20261003'); c=json.loads((p/'CANDIDATE-REVIEW-0-1.json').read_text()); a=json.loads((p/'CHANGES.json').read_text()); baseline='31c93a100507f57dfa39628f11b76af7410f6386'
assert len(a)==len(c['records'])==16
byid={r['id']:r for r in a}
fmt=re.compile(r'%(?:%|[-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?[cdiouxXeEfgGqs])')
for r in c['records']:
 assert all(r[k]==byid[r['id']][k] for k in byid[r['id']]),r['id']
 assert r['final_target']==r['new_target'],r['id']
 old,new=r['old_target'],r['new_target']
 assert fmt.findall(old)==fmt.findall(new),(r['id'],'format')
 assert re.findall(r'#[^#\n]+#',old)==re.findall(r'#[^#\n]+#',new),(r['id'],'markup')
 assert old.count('\n')==new.count('\n'),(r['id'],'newline')
 print(r['id'],'authorization/placeholder/markup/newline OK')
for f in c['files']:
 name=f['file']; old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',baseline+':'+name]); current=pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes(); rebuilt=old
 assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()==f['baseline_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()==f['final_sha256']
 for r in c['records']:
  if r['file']!=name: continue
  before=r['old_target'].encode(); after=r['new_target'].encode()
  assert rebuilt.count(before)==1,(r['id'],'not unique')
  loc=rebuilt.index(before)
  assert (rebuilt[loc-2:loc]==b'[[' and rebuilt[loc+len(before):loc+len(before)+2]==b']]') or (rebuilt[loc-1:loc]==b'"' and rebuilt[loc+len(before):loc+len(before)+1]==b'"'),(r['id'],'not full literal')
  assert r['source'].encode() in old,(r['id'],'source absent')
  rebuilt=rebuilt.replace(before,after,1)
 assert rebuilt==current,(name,'unauthorized bytes')
 print(name,'independent baseline -> exact target replacements == current bytes; hashes OK')
diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff',baseline,'--',*[f['file'] for f in c['files']]])
assert diff==(p/'CODE_DIFF-REVIEW-0-1.patch').read_bytes(),'frozen diff mismatch'
print('frozen patch == independently reproduced diff; all 16 checked')
